findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone across the full observed window [0.0,0.49]: it rises to a positive peak near t≈0.10-0.11, reverses to a deep negative trough near t≈0.18-0.20, partially recovers, and ends near its starting level. The whole-window mean z is small (-0.18) while first_rate_z (-17.5) and last_rate_z (+8.1) are large and opposite in sign, so the net window change is small but the within-window contrast is large.

The quadratic polynomial fit is not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE≈0.78) and the curve shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, so a single smooth global trend is not supported for this coordinate proxy; the observed node-level trajectory is the defensible evidence.
The learning/control support is [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support audit matches this window; no extrapolation beyond the observed nodes is permitted.

hypotheses.falsifier: No measurable increase in the early positive excursion of landmark_00_local_dx relative to the uniform-dose baseline, or a sign reversal of the early-region contrast.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx curve values over the observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: If guidance dose is redistributed toward the early portion of the observed window (t≈0.0-0.15), the landmark_00_local_dx proxy should show a larger positive excursion in that region than under uniform dose, because the observed curve already peaks positively there before reversing.

hypotheses.falsifier: No measurable deepening of the middle negative excursion of landmark_00_local_dx relative to the uniform-dose baseline, or a sign reversal of the middle-region contrast.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dx curve values over the observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: If guidance dose is redistributed toward the middle of the observed window (t≈0.15-0.35), the landmark_00_local_dx proxy should show a deeper negative excursion in that region, because the observed curve already troughs negatively there.

limitations: Only one coordinate proxy (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; other landmark coordinates and soft_mass features were not queried, so the temporal picture is incomplete.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves are accessible.
The polynomial fit is rejected and the curve has multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so no stable global trend or discovered stage boundary can be claimed.
Selection preference is association only; descendant survival and measured final affinity are not observed in this role input, so no claim about final benefit is made.
The registered dose recipes (W1/W2/W3) are proposed interventions, not optimal parameters learned from the observed slope.
